{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/interfaces/chain.h, node.h, and wallet.h, but per ipc guidelines, an interface change for wallet functionality is wallet-first and not ipc unless interface mechanics are the point.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Interface signature updates without changes to IPC mechanics, serialization, or multiprocess infrastructure belong to the respective functional area."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/net_processing.cpp and src/net_processing.h are mechanical caller updates adapting to the revised BroadcastTransaction signature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical call-site updates following an internal refactoring do not alter P2P network behavior or message protocols."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/rpc/mempool.cpp and src/rpc/util.cpp only adapt callers to the new interface and explicitly discard results to preserve current RPC behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Follow-up mechanical call updates in RPC code do not modify RPC interfaces or caller-visible behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Fuzz and unit test adjustments in src/test/fuzz/kitchen_sink.cpp and src/wallet/test/ test the modified wallet interfaces rather than test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Area-specific tests and caller updates belong to the wallet domain, not test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Small edits in src/common/messages.cpp adapt translated string handling to the updated error types.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Transaction error handling changes serve wallet broadcast logic rather than general utility primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries Wallet label and alters CWallet::CommitTransaction and interfaces::Wallet::commitTransaction to return structured broadcast errors.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a deceptive failure mode where frontends like the QML GUI report 'Transaction sent' even when the node rejected the transaction because CommitTransaction previously returned void. Returning structured TransactionBroadcastError enables callers to inform users when transactions fail submission."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
